changes.scientific_rationale: The selected version now has checked original GenTel-Shield and comparator binary input-classification methods that do not depend on a protected target answer. The previously supported goal-hijacking/prompt-leakage task scope remains. Translation destinations alone do not establish the evaluated English baseline, so language remains unresolved pending actual linked construction.

Checked repetition-distance and known-answer-logit thresholds establish binary input procedures evaluated before an original-task answer. However, the new arm inventory labels the task jailbreak versus benign. My prior input-task MET inferred injected-instruction detection too broadly from auxiliary probes; a separate instruction-injection evaluation still needs method support. This is a correction of an unsupported custodian assumption, not an exclusion. English template/task-component evidence is retained without claiming full evaluated-language composition.

Checked methods distinguish original/adversarial retrieval queries with input detectors, but optimize retrieval-ranking perturbations using token suffix search. Clean/adversarial labels alone do not establish detection of injected instructions. My previous input-task MET made that unsupported inference. Binary procedure and input-only timing remain supported; injection semantics and evaluated English remain unresolved.
